title: Career roadmap · Professor
summary: Build a research-led academic career in yoga, naturopathy and wellness sciences through rigorous research, publications, teaching, grants, doctoral supervision and academic leadership.

facts.Current degree: Ph.D. - Physical Education, Sports Science & Yoga
facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes the Ph.D. starts in 2026 and the target is an Indian academic career, with postdoctoral and international research options. The doctorate should produce a clear research identity, peer-reviewed publications, teaching evidence and a record of research activity. Current UGC regulations and amendments should be checked against each institution's recruitment notice because academic appointment requirements can change. UGC

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Complete the Ph.D., develop a defined yoga/wellness research niche, publish and build teaching experience.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Establish an independent research programme and become competitive for faculty, postdoctoral and funded-research positions.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Lead funded studies, supervise researchers, publish consistently and contribute to curriculum and academic governance.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Lead a research group/centre, develop international collaborations and connect yoga research with health and public-policy questions.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move beyond individual papers toward a coherent research programme. Develop expertise in reproducibility, implementation science, digital interventions, health economics and evidence translation while retaining a clear academic identity.
At Ph.D. level, research fellowships, project appointments and teaching/research positions are generally more relevant than conventional internships.

Career progression

Ph.D. Researcher → Research Fellow/Teaching Fellow
2030–2035: Assistant Professor / Postdoctoral Researcher → Independent Researcher
2035–2040: Associate Professor / Senior Researcher → Research Group Lead
2040–2046: Professor → Research Centre Director / Department Head / Dean
Ph.D. research routes

The strongest professor profile will combine a clear academic identity with high-quality evidence. By this stage, aim to lead funded research programmes, supervise doctoral scholars, publish consistently, develop international collaborations and contribute to curriculum and academic governance. The most valuable research will connect yoga and wellness science with measurable outcomes in health, education or public programmes while maintaining rigorous methodology and appropriate claims.
